description: List all folders in a space. Requires space_id or space_name. Use archived=true to include archived folders.

detail_level.description: Controls response verbosity. 'names' returns id/name/task_count only for efficient navigation. 'detailed' returns full metadata. Default: detailed.

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: list_folders
